options.title: What's Holding Up the Burj Khalifa?
options.first_line: The Burj Khalifa is the tallest building on Earth. So what's holding it up?
options.first_frame: The Burj Khalifa rising out of the frame in golden desert light, named at its base, cars passing, the depth meter at zero.

options.title: What's Under the Burj Khalifa?
options.first_line: Under the Burj Khalifa, there's a hidden forest of concrete. How deep does it go?
options.first_frame: The tower's base cut away at street level, the tops of concrete columns showing in the sand below, the meter at zero.

options.title: How Deep Does the Burj Khalifa Go?
options.first_line: The world's tallest tower needs something huge underneath. What's under the Burj Khalifa?
options.first_frame: The Burj Khalifa's base at sunset with traffic passing, the camera starting to tip down toward the sand, the meter at zero.

why: It names the world's tallest tower and asks how deep it goes without giving any of the answer away, unlike B's 'forest of concrete', and its first frame already tips the camera down toward the sand, so even with the sound off it promises the answer is just below.
